worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.summary: Spin the whole body to wind up, then bring the huge hammer down on the ground ahead; the impact drives a shockwave forward along the ground and shoves everything in its path. Recovery is long and the hammer cannot be raised again for a while, though using another move lets it recover early. Sweep style carries the hammer around in a full circle at some cost to power and tempo.
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.use.0: Spin up and bring the huge hammer down
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.use.1: Drive a ground shockwave to shove everything in its path
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.use.2: Sweep a full circle when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.descript: Hammer %1$s power, shockwave %2$s power (attack), slam point %3$s blocks, shockwave length %4$s blocks.
The shockwave has a %1$s-block half-width and pushes targets back %2$s blocks. Charge time: %3$s.
After the slam it cannot be used again for %1$s; using any other move lets the hammer recover early.

worldcombat.skill.gigatonhammer.preferen: On: the body carries the hammer around a full circle, everything around it takes the hammer and the shockwave is longer; power is x0.75 with +6 tick recovery and +8 tick cooldown. Off (overhead): the hammer lands on a point ahead and the shockwave drives forward, full power on the primary target.
Beyond this distance it will not swing the hammer and closes in first.
Below this health fraction it will not swing unless the target is nearly down. Higher values make it more protective and less likely to finish a weakened foe.
On (with sweep style): it swings more readily when other enemies stand near the target, since the circle catches them all; off ranks by the single-target payoff only.
